drug.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样蛋白治疗对合并脑淀粉样血管病的AD患者带来卒中诊疗与抗栓管理的全新挑战。

drug.title: Conformational modulation and inhibition of lysozyme amyloid fibrillation by lanthanum-doped red carbon dots: a multispectroscopic, morphological, and molecular simulation study.
drug.journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular a
drug.zh: 镧掺杂碳点结合溶菌酶非活性口袋，经构象调控抑制淀粉样纤维化。

drug.title: From public preferences to clinical tasks in anti-amyloid therapy for Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 日本患者对仑卡奈单抗的获益期望远超实际疗效，临床需全程管理预期。

drug.title: Clinical immunology lessons from failed α-Synuclein and Tau immunotherapies: A roadmap for combination strategies in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: α-突触核蛋白与tau免疫治疗失败揭示四大教训，指引AD联合免疫策略。

drug.title: Beyond Amyloid: Systemic and Brain Frailty as Determinants of Response to Anti-Amyloid Therapy in Alzheimer's Disease-A Conceptual Review.
drug.zh: 系统性和脑衰弱显著影响抗淀粉样治疗疗效与安全性，应纳入决策框架。

drug.title: Exosome-Based Therapeutics in Alzheimer's Disease: Translational Perspectives Beyond Conventional Therapies.
drug.zh: 外泌体凭借天然血脑屏障穿透力与多靶点递送能力，成为超越现有抗淀粉样抗体的阿尔茨海默病治疗新平台。

drug.title: Cerebral amyloid-β burden and white matter injury: associations, clues for underlying mechanisms, and implication on cognitive trajectory after lecanemab therapy.
drug.zh: 仑卡奈单抗疗效受基线白质损伤影响，Aβ负荷可预测WMH进展并介导认知轨迹。

drug.title: A Metabolomics-Based Strategy for Identifying Endogenous Inhibitors of IAPP Aggregation.
drug.zh: 基于代谢组学策略发现内源性代谢物可抑制IAPP聚集，为T2DM治疗提供新靶点。

mech.title: Quantitative Assessment of Cerebrospinal Fluid-Vascular Association in Alzheimer's Disease Using Phase-Contrast and 4D-Flow Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
mech.zh: 相位对比与4D血流MRI证实阿尔茨海默病中脑脊液-血管耦合功能显著受损。

mech.title: Effect of MALT1 inhibition by MI‑2 on the microglial phenotype switch, inflammatory cytokine secretion, neuronal loss and oxidative stress in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 抑制MALT1可减轻AD中Aβ诱导的小胶质细胞炎症、神经元损伤与氧化应激。

mech.title: Synergistic Regulation of Alzheimer's Disease and Intestinal Microbiota Metabolism Mediated by the Gut-Brain Axis: A Comprehensive Analysis from a Multidisciplinary Perspective.
mech.zh: 肠道菌群经肠脑轴双向调控代谢与免疫，其失衡或为AD核心病理协同驱动因素。

mech.title: The APOE4-estrogen-microglia axis in perimenopausal cognitive changes: mechanisms and therapeutic implications.
mech.zh: APOE4与围绝经期雌激素骤降协同驱动小胶质细胞功能障碍，构成女性AD风险升高的关键机制。

mech.title: Identification of interleukin-11 as a comorbid risk factor for prostate cancer and Alzheimer's disease using integrated bioinformatics and machine learning.
mech.zh: 整合多组学与机器学习，锁定IL-11为前列腺癌与阿尔茨海默病共病风险因子。

mech.title: The Crosstalk Between Diabetes and Alzheimer's Disease: A Molecular Perspective.
mech.zh: 糖尿病与阿尔茨海默病共享胰岛素抵抗及PI3K/Akt通路异常，致GSK-3β激活促tau过度磷酸化。

mech.title: A third-generation, high-affinity biparatopic anti-tau antibody inhibits intracellular tau aggregation seeded by Alzheimer's brain extracts.
mech.zh: 第三代双表位抗tau抗体NIDB-3101以亚纳摩尔亲和力高效抑制AD脑提取物诱导的细胞内tau聚集。

mech.title: Diagnostic performance of plasma pTau217 in genetically admixed South American populations.
mech.zh: 血浆pTau217在巴西和阿根廷混血人群中仍能精准识别阿尔茨海默病淀粉样病理。

dx.title: Blood-based biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease and neurodegeneration in an indigenous African cohort using both Simoa and NULISA platforms.
dx.zh: 非洲人群血浆p-tau217等指标随痴呆严重度阶梯性升高，支持AD血液标志物跨种族适用性。

dx.title: Comparison of baseline characteristics between cognitively normal and mild cognitive impairment and association of white matter hyperintensity trajectories with diagnostic outcomes, cognition, and amyloid-β protein: A longitudinal study.
dx.zh: 基线白质高信号及纵向轨迹可独立预测认知正常或轻度障碍者的阿尔茨海默病进展及Aβ沉积。

dx.title: Peripheral blood microarray-based transcriptomic and epigenetic analyses identify immune, inflammation, and metabolic dysregulation in Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 外周血多组学揭示AD免疫激活、炎症及代谢抑制，且受APOE ε4显著影响。

dx.title: From amyloid PET to plasma biomarkers: A multimodal imaging framework for early diagnosis and staging of Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 多模态影像联合血浆标志物可精准实现AD早期诊断与分期。

dx.title: Longitudinal Dynamics of the Blood Proteome Within the Alzheimer Spectrum in Down Syndrome.
dx.zh: 唐氏综合征阿尔茨海默谱系血浆蛋白纵向轨迹揭示早期病理动态及认知衰退关联。

dx.title: Model-based ordering of the ALPS index among Alzheimer's disease biomarkers.
dx.zh: ALPS指数异常介于血浆Aβ42/40改变与淀粉样PET阳性之间，先于tau病理。

dx.title: Brain-derived plasma p-tau217 shows enhanced dynamic range for Alzheimer's disease neuropathological change.
dx.zh: 脑源性p-tau217较总p-tau217动态范围更宽，更精准反映AD神经病理改变。

dx.title: Machine learning for the prediction of amyloid PET positivity using plasma biomarkers, cognition, APOE genotype, and structural imaging.
dx.zh: 多模态机器学习整合血浆与影像指标可精准预测淀粉样PET阳性状态。

prev.title: Seafood and polyunsaturated fatty acid intake and age-related hearing loss: a cross-sectional study conducted in Japan.
prev.journal: The journal of nutrition, health & a
prev.zh: 日本中老年人群海鲜及n-3多不饱和脂肪酸摄入与年龄相关性听力损失风险无关。

prev.title: Adipose tissue plays a crucial role in obesity-induced postoperative neurocognitive disorders.
prev.zh: 肥胖通过脂肪组织加剧术后神经认知障碍，干预脂肪或可缓解。

prev.title: Natural history and clinical impact of epilepsy in adults with Down syndrome: a multicentre clinical study.
prev.zh: 唐氏综合征成人癫痫多发于阿尔茨海默病症状期，提示预后更差。

prev.title: Aging as a Continuation of Development: A Hypothesis and Framework.
prev.zh: 衰老是记忆系统从海马向皮层优化的发育延续，而非衰退代偿。

prev.title: Association between Alzheimer's disease-related genes and neurodegenerative blood-based biomarkers in Indian adults.
prev.zh: 印度成人中AD风险基因变异与血液神经退行性生物标志物显著关联。

prev.title: Network-level functional connectivity is associated with longitudinal tau accumulation and amyloid-dependent cognitive decline in preclinical Alzheimer's disease.
prev.zh: 静息态功能连接降低预示临床前AD患者tau蛋白沉积与认知衰退风险。

prev.title: Cross-sectional associations of loneliness with plasma p-tau217 and neurofilament light chain in dementia-free older adults in the INSPIRE-T baseline cohort.
prev.zh: 孤独感与痴呆前老年人血浆p-tau217及NfL水平升高独立相关。

prev.title: Robust inference and correlates from genetic associations with personality.
prev.zh: 该研究通过大规模跨族裔荟萃分析，揭示人格遗传关联的稳健性及家庭内效应，并定位1260个关键变异。

intro.title: The Crosstalk Between Diabetes and Alzheimer's Disease: A Molecular Perspective.
intro.zh: 糖尿病和老年痴呆看着不搭边，其实体内都跟“胰岛素失灵”有关，看懂这点，控好血糖或许能帮脑子防老。

intro.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
intro.zh: 讲的是治阿尔茨海默病的新药对脑部血管有影响，提醒有血管问题的老人用药前要查脑，防中风或出血风险。

intro.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
intro.zh: 科学家用干细胞造出“迷你人脑”来研究老年痴呆，帮咱们搞清发病原因，好提前预防和治疗。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用一滴血查几个关键蛋白，提前发现阿尔茨海默病，让普通人不用做腰穿或昂贵脑扫描就能早筛查。

intro.title: Microglia in Alzheimer's disease: Insights into disease progression and therapy.
intro.zh: 大脑里的清洁工一旦累坏了，病就加重；看懂这点，才能明白新药为啥瞄准它。

intro.title: Menopausal insomnia as a modifiable node of dementia risk: Mechanistic insights and intervention strategies.
intro.zh: 更年期睡不好，可能悄悄增加以后得老年痴呆的风险，早点调理睡眠，就是给大脑上保险。

intro.title: Advances in the clinical application of mesenchymal stem cells for neurological disorders.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用干细胞治疗老年痴呆等脑部疾病的新进展，对普通人来说，就是了解未来可能多一种延缓病情的办法。

intro.title: Gantenerumab for Early Alzheimer's Disease: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
intro.zh: 一种叫“甘特单抗”的新药，对早期老年痴呆效果还不确定，这篇研究帮您看清它到底有没有用。
